h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, י״ד Ki Seitzei, 14
Oral Torah Brings Hidden Wisdom Into the Heart

p: as that of the Holy Ancient One;
and therefore at this meal we say:
it counts the morning prayer of Shabbos,
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
that the holiness of the three prayers
and of the three meals is one.
וְכֵן בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג פב, א)
And so in the holy Zohar (III 82a)
corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah";
and the intent is the attribute of Binah,
in truth this meal is reckoned
as corresponding to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who merited the attribute of "old age,"
the aspect of the Holy Ancient One,
which is the intellect hidden from all thought.
and there is no grasp or comprehension of it at all,
"This is the meal of the Holy Ancient One"?
But it says in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 18):
of the Work of Creation," etc.;
and the intent is the twenty-eight letters
And so it is explicitly in the Tikkunim
are twenty-eight letters, the upper Shechinah," etc.
which is the intellect hidden from all thought;
and therefore "And He said" is not said of it,
for there is no grasp of it at all;
"By the word of Hashem the heavens were made"
she has hewn out her seven pillars":
זוֹ מִידָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
this is the attribute of the Holy One, Blessed is He"
"Who created the whole world with wisdom;
'she has hewn out her seven pillars'
these are the seven days of Creation."
of the Holy One, Blessed is He."
alludes to the aspect of the Oral Torah.
as is written: "Malchus is the mouth;
we call it the Oral Torah"
that is what the Sages originate
with their intellect in the Oral Torah,
which is called the lower Chochmah,
But the essential illumination that comes to them
from the aspect of Keser Elyon,
which is the tip of the Yud,
which is a crown and a tag.
And it is found in the Kabbalists
that the essence of the sefirah of Keser Elyon
is wondrous and hidden from all thought;
only the tip of the Yud
is the illumination from Keser Elyon
it alludes to the attribute of Binah,
which is the aspect of the Oral Torah;
because right at the beginning of the Thought
before Him, may His Name be blessed,
that there would be free choice,
which is the deeds of the wicked,
these are the deeds of the wicked," etc.
עַל יְדֵי כֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
through the power of the Oral Torah,
that comes to rectify the "much vexation."
And through teshuvah out of love
like these years that are ordered, etc.,
they shall become white as snow"
and out of everything there will be "very good."
And this is alluded to in the tip of the Yud,
which is the light from Keser Elyon
that shines to the aspect of Chochmah
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon;
and through it is the joining of
the aspect of the supernal Mother,
as is written in the Tikkunim mentioned above.

p: is also called "ko'ach mah" (the power of "what"),
there is as yet no understanding at all,
which is why it is called "ko'ach mah,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (הַקְדָּמַת זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ א, ב)
as is written (introduction to the holy Zohar, 1b):
is what shines from there into the heart,
to understand in the Oral Torah;
That is, the strength and the understanding
in those who originate new insight in the Oral Torah
which is understanding one thing from another,
as is written in the Tikkunim.
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was the first of the converts
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
not so Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was born holy from the womb
And so in the Kedushah d'Sidra,
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
it says: "Holy in the highest heavens above,
indicates the aspect of the Holy Ancient One,
הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
is only through "the abode of His Presence,"
is the intellect hidden from all thought,
of which there is no grasp at all;
whose attribute is Chesed, as is known,
and Aharon is the root of the Oral Torah,
"and he shall be a mouth for you"
and he too is on the right,
as is written in the holy Zohar.
And therefore the Oral Torah is called
for it shines from Keser Elyon
to the tip of the Yud,
to the joining of Chochmah and Binah.
And as is known, the letters Yud-Hei
and the final Hei to the attribute of Malchus;
and the tip of the Yud
alludes to the aspect of Keser Elyon,
which shines through it to Chochmah
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon.
אִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
it says in the holy Zohar (I 47b):
"'And God completed on the seventh day'
this one, the world was perfected";
for the perfecting was on Shabbos
which was needed after the corruption
the seventh day too with Chochmah,
as they said in the Gemara
"'She has hewn out her seven pillars'
these are the seven days of Creation"
the attribute of Malchus, the lower Shechinah,
and with understanding it is established."
that is, with the Written Torah,
with which the world was created;
which understands one thing from another;
that is, the perfecting of the world,
as is written in the holy Zohar:
"for through it the world was perfected."
And this is what we say:
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
And it says in the Pri Etz Chaim
that on Shabbos he returns to Yisrael
the crowns they merited at Sinai.
"And Moshe merited all of them and took them";
he returns the crowns to Yisrael,
and there is abundance in the Oral Torah:
בִּרְכַּת ה׳ הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר (מִשְׁלֵי י, כב)
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich" (Mishlei 10:22)

paragraphs.text: Source: Mishlei 24:3 — “בחכמה יבנה בית ובתבונה יתכונן” — “A house is built by wisdom, And is established by understanding;”

paragraphs.text: Source: Mishlei 10:22 — “ברכת יהוה היא תעשיר ולא יוסף עצב עמה” — “It is the blessing of GOD that enriches, And no toil can increase it.”
